text:
Explicit limited structural revision of this unexecuted proposal. Preserve the four accepted requirements and every public input/output contract exactly, including the enum completion status and fixed workbook destination. Preserve requested search/navigation, individual product visits, real document writing and Browser cleanup. Restructure only data adaptation and the invalid dependent bindings/requires; remove the unrequested optional action and its supporting condition/data. Add no other goals, filters, deduplication or consent actions. Do not change limits, permissions or accepted output nullability.

Correct every malformed field binding, including immutable requires and exports. The exact binding syntax is: {"kind":"field","port":"text","items":[{"kind":"item"}]} for a current record field; {"kind":"output","source":"decisionTask","port":"selectedIds"} for a declared result port; {"kind":"field","port":"propertyName","items":[{"kind":"output","source":"producer"}]} only when that producer's whole output has the declared object property. The port is the PROPERTY NAME, never a task ID; the operand is a typed binding, never a string naming a property. Never field on an array, including index/length. Use actual discovered operation contracts and scoped captures/exports.

At each complete observation-consuming stage: validate the actual acquisition success and completeness metadata before adaptation; use transform mode extract with inputs.pages bound to the complete bounded pages and each:{input:"pages",output:"rows"}. resultType is the COMPLETE assembled result: rows is nonnullable array<nonnullable array<nonnullable compact candidate object>>. Every page executes; every observed candidate required for the decision remains represented, including outside generation examples. Flatten exactly one level into the global decision input. Interpretation receives only declared compact fields, never the raw snapshot alongside them. Preserve the full originals separately through minimal typed page-record projection and explicit flatten. Keep references verbatim; no invented IDs, indices, action arguments or fallback facts.

Decisions return unchanged offered IDs only. Validate selected IDs by strict lookup on offered candidates, then reconnect the SAME IDs against original records. Example foreach requires: predicate(not_equal, lookup(port:"reference",items:[offeredRecords,selectedIds]), null); foreach items: lookup(port:"reference",items:[originalRecords,selectedIds]). Repetitions and order remain unchanged; no filtering/deduplication. URLs/references for MCP actions come only from those original records. Guard nullable IDs before lookup. Lookup always returns an array; project fields inside a bounded typed foreach, never through learned copying or field(array,...). Capture outer item values explicitly when nested item scopes need them.

For each visited product, choose observed fact-block IDs from narrow per-page extraction. Resolve chosen IDs against offered blocks then original blocks and copy one whole observed name/description/price text block verbatim. Missing facts may be permitted null fields in NONNULL product objects, never unrelated URLs/placeholders/reworded text. An interface affordance is not a business error; errors require actual producer evidence. Keep complete observations and original metadata outside global interpretation.

Remove interpretation used only for already typed product projection, row construction, status flags or output-path copying. Export typed product records and nullable string cell rows directly from the existing scopes; retain minimal bounded projections only where required. Bind document rows deterministically as flatten([[headerRow],productRows]), with the extra nesting preserving the header row. Supply name,description,price,error headers in that order and exact observed values/nulls. Return the successful writer's declared path output. Completion status must follow actual successful prerequisites/writer results through existing typed predicates/branches/direct bindings, never inferred success. Require the necessary collection bounds before writing; empty/unusable observations must fail explicitly. Keep all existing real validation and local requires.

This revision is limited to correcting these defects; preserve the accepted business work and cleanup. Produce a valid typed TaskPlan through the existing schema, with no JavaScript, new operators, or fabricated defaults.
